sub: For High School Graduates, College Graduates, Graduate School Graduates, Trade School Graduates, and GED Graduates

hook.h2: Everyone is asking what comes next. Your Father already knows, and He is going with you
hook.text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be discouraged, for I, your Father, am with you wherever you go.”
father: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be discouraged, for I, your Father, am with you wherever you go.”
hook.note: Joshua stood at the edge of a land he had never walked, with Moses gone and a whole people looking to him. Our Father did not hand him a map first. He gave him a promise. Wherever you go from here, you do not go alone. Your future is in your Father’s hands.

short350: High school and college graduates, trade school and GED graduates, graduate school and seminary graduates, and every graduate stepping into what comes next: the Graduate's Bible from Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the Holy Bible made for you.

Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color™ is a complete Bible, Old and New Testaments, in a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek that reveals God as your Father. It is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's words in RED, the Spirit's words in PURPLE.
It equips you to receive the Father, hear His voice, and know His heart is for you.

For high school and college graduates, master's and doctoral graduates, nursing, MBA and seminary graduates, trade school and cosmetology graduates, GED graduates and adult learners, homeschool graduates, basic training and boot camp graduates, and young adults starting a first job. For every next step: college, trade school, the military, a first job, the mission field, starting a business or moving away.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page.

A graduate walks out of one life and into another with the same question in every conversation. Our Father answered it long before anyone asked: "For I know the plans I have for you, declares your Father—plans for peace, not disaster, to give you a future and hope." He is not waiting for a degree, a job, or a plan before He speaks. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so a graduate hears Him for themselves in the years that decide the most.
An interpretive translation with a stated theological emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Not a paraphrase — every word is rendered from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: He Has Been Speaking The Whole Time
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

long.h: Everyone Is Asking What Is Next. Your Father Already Knows.
body: A graduate walks out of one life and into another with the same question in every conversation. Our Father answered it long before anyone asked: "For I know the plans I have for you, declares your Father—plans for peace, not disaster, to give you a future and hope."

He is not waiting for a degree, a job, or a plan before He speaks. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so a graduate hears Him for themselves in the years that decide the most.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal. This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: Abba Father, your Heavenly Father, and you, His beloved son or daughter. If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Graduate's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — with a cover and opening pages made for a graduate. Those pages include a dedication, Where to Turn, and a presentation page for their name. Everything from Genesis 1:1 onward is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is the Graduate's Bible a complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses, 890 pages, full color throughout. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,355 study notes run through the whole Bible.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for graduates?
faq.a: It is made for it. A 6 x 9 Bible in hardcover or paperback with a presentation page for their name, in a cover made for graduates rather than a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
